about: ADHAM: supply the WhatsApp business number here, digits only in international format (country code + number, no +, no spaces, no leading 0), then rebuild. While it is empty the build shows NO WhatsApp link anywhere (no broken wa.me link). When it is set, the build adds a https://wa.me/<number> link to the footer and the About page contact section. Also update the 'by email only' wording (about.contact.p, faq.18a1, terms.who.p) in all four languages at the same time.
